GOVERNMENT MEDICAL COLLEGE, RAJANNA SIRCILLA
NOTIFICATION FOR THE POSTS OF PROFESSORS, ASSOCIATE PROFESSORS, ASSISTANT
PROFESSORS, CAS SPECIALISTS UNDER ICU OF VARIOUS SPECIALITIES ON CONTRACT BASIS
AND SENIOR RESIDENTS ON HONORARIUM BASIS.
NOTIFICATION NO: 06/2026,
1. Applications are invited from the eligible candidates for Professors, Associate Professors,
Assistant Professors, CAS Specialists under ICU on Contract basis and Senior Residents on Honorarium
basis of various Departments to work in Government Medical College/Government General Hospital,
Rajanna sircilla for a period up to 31.03.2027 or till the actual need ceases (or) till the regular posts are
filled up whichever is earlier as per G.O. Rt. No. 1276 Finance (HRM.VII) Department, dated 16th July
2026.
2. Walk-in Interview & Original Certificate Verification: Dated: 26.11.2026.
Venue: MEU Hall, First floor, Government Medical College, Rajanna sircilla.

Selection Criteria Candidates will be selected based on the following criteria:
For Professor and Associate Professor
The duration of their teaching experience in that Cadre will be considered for Selection Criteria.
For Assistant Professor posts Marks obtained in MD/MS/DNB/PG Degree.
75% Marks in Qualifying Exams, 10 Marks 1 mark for 1 year after possessing PG Degree maximum ceiling 10 marks,
10 Marks 2 marks for each index publications. 5 Marks for Interview (If marks are not awarded in the qualifying exam
50% of marks will be considered)
For the Post of CAS (ICU) (Specialist)
Marks obtained in MD/MS/DNB/Diploma in PG Degree will be awarded for 90% for Qualifying Examination and 10
Marks 1 mark for 1 year after possessing PG Degree maximum ceiling 10 marks
For the Post of Senior Resident
Marks obtained in MD/MS/DNB/DM/M.Ch PG Degree will be awarded for 100%
Rule of Reservation will be followed wherever applicable.

5. Non-local candidates must register their qualifications with Telangana State Medical Council within one week
of selection for their appointment to be confirmed.
6. The appointment as contract employee is purely on a temporary basis up to 31.03.2027, or until the vacancies
are filled by promotion or regular appointment, or until the need ceases, whichever is earlier. This contract
placement does not confer any right to a future government appointment.
7. DNB Candidates will be selected as per the latest existing NMC guidelines.
8. The selection of candidates will be nationwide. However, first preference will be given to local candidates of
Multi zone-I for Assistant Professor and CAS positions. If local candidates are not available, candidates from
other zone will be considered. Professors & Associate Professors are belonging to the state cadre.
9. The age of the applicant (Faculty) should be below 69 years on the day of notification.
10. The selected candidate must submit a relieving order from their previous Institute; failing to do so will result in
their selection being cancelled.
11. During the period of contract, the faculty will be paid a consolidated monthly remuneration depending on
the post, as per G.O. Rt. No 1276, Finance (HRM. VII) Department dated 16th July 2026.
12. The remuneration shall be all-inclusive and subject to deduction at source and any other statutory
deductions required under the law.
Consolidated Pay to Faculty:
Sl. No Name of the Post Consolidated Remuneration
1. Professor Rs.1,90,000/- per month
2. Associate Professor Rs.1,50,000/- per month
3. Assistant Professor Rs.1,25,000/- per month
4. CAS Specialist Under ICU Rs.1,00,000/- per month
5. Senior Residents Rs.1,06,461/- per month
13. The posts are classified into Multi-Zonal and State cadres, and local reservations are applicable.
14. Local Reservation (95%) is applicable for the post of Assistant Professors, and CAS Specialists under ICU,
per Para 8 of G.O.Ms.No.124 General Administration (SPF-MC) Department dated 30.08.2018
15. The selected Faculty will be eligible for 15 casual leaves in a calendar year as per
existing norms.
16. The selected candidate should submit their original certificates at the time of joining, along with a one year
bond on a Rs.100 stamp paper duly notarized to the concerned Principal of the Medical College. If any
candidate breaks the bond, he/she has to pay 3 months’ salary.
17. The contract is liable to be terminated at any time with a one-month notice, without assigning any reason what
so ever. Similarly, the selected faculty may also terminate the Contract at any time with one month's notice.
18. The Selected Candidates must join their duties within 1 week on receiving their appointment orders.
19. The engaged faculty will be under the administration control of the institute on a whole time basis, and his/her
service may be utilized in any manner required by the competent authority of the institute, without any claims
for any additional remuneration.
20. The application form will be available at the college website https://gmcrajannasircilla.org/ Filled in
Application form should be submitted along with Xerox copies of documents mentioned below and on the
Day of interview and individual should carry all original Certificates also.
21. The applicants need to submit the following documents:
a) Filled in application form.
b) Aadhaar Card and PAN card
c) Proof of Date of Birth (SSC/Birth certificate)
d) Study/ Bonafide certificates 1 to 7 class.
e) MBBS and MD/MS/DNB Degree.
f) MBBS Registration from Telangana State Medical Council, and additional PG Qualification
registration from Telangana State Medical Council only.
Non-local candidates must get their qualifications registered from Telangana State Medical Council
within one week of selection, for their appointment to be confirmed.
g) Copy of experience certificate for all State Government Hospitals/Institutions/ Programmes on
contract/honorarium basis appointments.
h) Senior Resident Experience Certificate (in case of Assistant Professor)
i) Copies of Publications with proof of Indexation
Note 1:- The Original Certificates MBBS, MD/MS/DNB Degree along with MBBS Registration and
M.S/M.D/DNB Specialty Degree Registration and experience certificate have to be submitted at
the time joining, and will be under the custody of Principal, Government Medical College,
Rajanna Sircilla.
Note 2:- Applications which are not properly filled up or without necessary Enclosures will be summarily rejected.
